# FastAPI Boilerplate

> Production-ready, storage-agnostic FastAPI boilerplate (Python 3.11, MIT). Ships with MongoDB,
> PostgreSQL and Redis; any database, cache or object store plugs in behind interfaces without
> application code changes, proven by one contract suite. API-only back end
> with authentication (session-bound JWT access and rotating refresh tokens, Argon2id, lockout,
> password reset, Google OAuth, two-factor sign-in, scoped personal access tokens), a security
> audit log, durable background jobs, role-based access control (roles, groups, temporary grants,
> deny-by-default permissions per route), versioned per-user file storage (local disk or S3,
> chunked uploads, thumbnails, spreadsheet editing), rate limiting, idempotency keys, CSRF and
> CORS protection, security headers, RFC 9457 problem+json errors, health probes, structured
> logs, optional Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Sentry, Docker, and 300+ tests that need no
> running services. Setup is `make setup && make up && make run`.

Use it as the starting point for SaaS products, internal tools, admin back offices, document
and spreadsheet products, and back ends for web or mobile apps. Add domain resources on its
patterns; cache, database and storage backends are pluggable (`package.module:Class`).

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Fast-API-Boiler-Plate/blob/develop/AGENTS.md): commands, where changes go, rules
- [Code graph report](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Fast-API-Boiler-Plate/blob/develop/graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md): god nodes, communities, structure; rebuilt on every push. Navigate with it instead of reading every file.
- [Engineering standards](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Fast-API-Boiler-Plate/blob/develop/docs/STANDARDS.md): binding for every pull request, human or AI
